segments.speaker: SPEAKER_1_PRIMARY
segments.text: Good evening sir, do you know why I pulled you over tonight?
segments.label: person:Police:Primary

segments.text: No officer, I'm not sure what I did wrong.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_2_AUDIO
segments.label: person:Civilian:Driver

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_1_PRIMARY
segments.text: You were going 47 in a 35 mile per hour zone. Can I see your license and registration please?
segments.label: person:Police:Primary

segments.text: Oh I'm sorry, I didn't realize. Let me get that for you right now.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_2_AUDIO
segments.label: person:Civilian:Driver

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_1_PRIMARY
segments.text: Take your time sir. Is there anything in the vehicle I should know about?
segments.label: person:Police:Primary

segments.text: No nothing like that. Here is my license.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_2_AUDIO
segments.label: person:Civilian:Driver

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_1_PRIMARY
segments.text: Thank you. I'm also going to need your proof of insurance. Please stay in the vehicle.
segments.label: person:Police:Primary

segments.text: Of course officer. Is everything okay?
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_2_AUDIO
segments.label: person:Civilian:Driver

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_2_BACKUP
segments.text: Backup unit checking in. All clear on the perimeter.
segments.label: person:Police:NonPrimary

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_1_PRIMARY
segments.text: Sir your license comes back clean. I'm going to issue you a written warning today. Please slow down in residential zones.
segments.label: person:Police:Primary

segments.text: Thank you officer. I really appreciate that. I will definitely be more careful.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_2_AUDIO
segments.label: person:Civilian:Driver

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_1_PRIMARY
segments.text: You're free to go. Drive safe tonight and have a good evening.
segments.label: person:Police:Primary
